verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes a public pricing page with search-count-based plans, including a Free tier at "$0 / month 250 searches per month". It describes self-serve plan mechanics such as Automatic Early Renewal when searches run out, and clear metering rules: cached searches are free and do not count toward monthly searches. The evidence does not quote paid-tier dollar amounts, so per-search cost on paid plans can only be inferred. missing for 10: explicit paid-plan prices or per-search cost figures, independent or community confirmation that pricing is fully self-serve without contacting sales.
